discovery_path.inherited_ground: BRAIN hunter s46: inspect the declared Arbor/HTR lineage for prewrite, atomic commit and restart reconciliation
discovery_path.query_surface: public GitHub search followed by the repository's licensed Arbor skill and state manager
discovery_path.selection_note: The implementation claims a persistent auditable hypothesis tree and held-out merge gate, making its actual state transitions direct falsifiers for the candidate-conservation and untouched-evidence repairs already under study.

evidence: cmd_add_node writes a pending node before dispatch and cmd_set_status can mark it running before evaluation
cmd_prune persists a reason and the Observe projection exposes pruned lessons to later ideation
cmd_set_evidence separates the factual result from a distilled insight and branch reference
findings.economic_disposition: KEEP the process shapes: create identity before evaluation, retain falsified branches as negative constraints, and separate raw result from reusable inference. They strengthen the existing repair but create no market evidence or promotion authority.

evidence: cmd_init sets best_test_score to null and never evaluates or records M_0 on the held-out evaluator
cmd_merge.better returns true whenever the prior best score is null
therefore the first candidate is marked merged for any finite test score, including a score worse than the initial artifact
findings.economic_disposition: REJECT the source's held-out merge gate as capital or validation evidence. A real baseline must be measured and identity-bound before any candidate; missing baseline is UNMEASURED, never permission to merge.

evidence: every cmd_merge call records test_score into the tree and updates the best score visible to later Observe and Decide cycles
the same test evaluator is reused for successive candidates with no cohort rotation, alpha spending, lockbox retirement or one-use evidence rule
later hypotheses can therefore condition on prior held-out outcomes even though the skill says E_test must not guide search
findings.economic_disposition: REJECT repeated test-score feedback as untouched evidence. Dev may guide search; an exposed test cohort becomes selection evidence after first use and cannot retain promotion authority without a fresh preregistered cohort or an anytime-valid sequential design.

evidence: _save uses one fixed sibling path obtained with path.with_suffix('.tmp') for every writer
there is no lock, compare-and-swap version, exclusive temporary name, fsync or parent-directory durability step
each mutating command loads the whole JSON object and replaces it, so concurrent coordinators can overwrite one another after reading the same prior state
findings.economic_disposition: REJECT tree.json/run.json as a multi-writer durable ledger. Keep replaceable controller state separate from an append-before-evaluate immutable trial ledger; fence writers and detect stale versions before replace.

evidence: a node may be marked running before dispatch, but no command detects a dead executor or converts abandoned running state to a typed terminal outcome
validate checks parent/status consistency only and does not reconcile running nodes with worktrees or evaluator processes
set_evidence accepts a status override without checking it against VALID_STATUS
findings.economic_disposition: REJECT completion/candidate-conservation claims. Restart must reconcile every prewritten identity to completed, failed, blocked or explicitly unattempted; a stranded running node is measured inventory, not evidence.

mt5_translation.disposition: These are universal research-integrity mechanisms over terminal-enumerated Fusion candidates, not alpha features. No symbol, direction, timeframe or market hypothesis was invented.
